skill_name: Predict what would happen if earth's atmosphere suddenly disappeared
workflow: If the Earth's atmosphere suddenly disappeared, the consequences would be catastrophic. This drastic drop in temperature would cause all the water on the planet to freeze, leading to the extinction of all forms of life.
